name: Radošovice (České Budějovice District, Czechia)
description: White field with a green chevron and a blue chevron pointing towards the fly, the blue continued as a blue triangle at the lower fly, and a blue fleur-de-lis at the hoist.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 27 May 2008 (decision No. 32) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
